blocks.text: Adrenal medulla do hormones banata hai: epinephrine aur norepinephrine (jinhein baalitarteeb adrenaline aur noradrenaline bhi kehte hain). Jab insan stress (dabao ya khatre) mein ho to medulla epinephrine aur norepinephrine chhorta hai. Yeh hormones jism ko “fight or flight” (lado ya bhago) ke liye tayyar karte hain. Is jawab mein dil ki dharkan tez hoti hai, blood pressure barhta hai, bronchioles (phephron ki chhoti nalyan) phail jati hain, khoon ka glucose barhta hai, aur jild aur hazme ke aaza ko khoon kam jata hai.

blocks.title: For Information: medulla aur cortex ka qaboo
blocks.text: Adrenal medulla ke hormones ka chhootna nervous system qaboo karta hai, jabke adrenal cortex ke hormones ka chhootna anterior pituitary ke hormones qaboo karte hain.
